title: Flutter Debug Adapter Configuration
description: Runs a Flutter app under Flutter's debug adapter, hot reloading it when a .dart file under lib/ is saved.

request.description: Launch the app, or attach to one that runs already

program.description: The entry point, relative to cwd

cwd.description: The Flutter project's directory; the worktree root by default

target.description: The kind of device to run on: a running one is picked, or an iOS Simulator or Android emulator started; ignored when deviceId or toolArgs name a device

deviceId.description: The device to run on (`flutter devices`), passed as `-d <deviceId>`; Flutter picks one when unset

flutterMode.description: The build mode; hot reload and hot restart work in debug mode

env.description: Environment variables for the Flutter tool

vmServiceUri.description: The VM service URI to attach to (attach requests)

useFvm.description: Run Flutter and Dart through fvm

hotReloadOnSave.description: Hot reload when a .dart file under lib/ is saved

devTools.description: Serve Flutter DevTools for the app, for the Flutter DevTools tasks, and open in Zed the widget selected in its inspector
